title: Market range: The Fed's rate is 4.50% after April: two more rises
html:
Market range

0.0%–64.0%

The Fed's rate is 4.50% after April: two more rises

Forecast40.3%
Upper bound64.0%
0%100%

What sets the lower bound

  1. “The Fed's rate is 4.50% after April: two more rises” is one way “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” can turn out

What sets the upper bound

  1. YES ask on “Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.50% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?”, for “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”: 85.0%
  2. YES ask on “Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.25% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?”, for “The Fed's rate is 4.50% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”: 85.0%
  3. “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” implies “The Fed's rate is 4.50% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”
